title: Create Google login button component

- Must preserve current locale in callback URL

- Create file: src/features/auth/ui/google-login-button.tsx
- Client component ('use client')
- Import Button from @/shared/ui/button
- Import Loader2 icon from lucide-react
- Import useLocale from next-intl
- Define BACKEND_OAUTH_URL constant (http://localhost:8080/api/v1/auth/login-google)
- State: isLoading (boolean)
- Handle: onClick sets loading, constructs callback URL, redirects via window.location.href
- Callback URL: ${window.location.origin}/${locale}/auth/callback
- Final OAuth URL: BACKEND_OAUTH_URL?redirect_uri=${encodeURIComponent(callbackUrl)}

title: Create OAuth callback route handler
description:
Create route handler at src/app/[locale]/auth/callback/route.ts to handle BE OAuth redirect

**Context**:
- BE redirects to /[locale]/auth/callback with 3 URL parameters
- Must extract locale from pathname dynamically
- Must validate parameters and create NextAuth session

**Implementation**:
- Create file: src/app/[locale]/auth/callback/route.ts
- Export GET handler function
- Extract locale from pathname: /vi/auth/callback → locale='vi'
- Extract searchParams: user_id, access_token, email, error
- If error parameter exists, redirect to /[locale]/login?error=xxx
- If required params missing, redirect to /[locale]/login?error=missing_params
- Call signIn('oauth', { userId, email, accessToken, redirect: false })
- If signIn fails, redirect to /[locale]/login?error=session_failed
- On success, redirect to /[locale]/dashboard
- Wrap in try-catch with redirect to /[locale]/login?error=callback_error

**Files**:
- src/app/[locale]/auth/callback/route.ts (CREATE)

**Acceptance Criteria**:
- [ ] Route handler created at correct path
- [ ] Locale extracted correctly from pathname (vi/en)
- [ ] All 3 required parameters validated
- [ ] Error cases redirect to login with error codes
- [ ] Successful OAuth redirects to dashboard
- [ ] All redirects preserve locale
- [ ] signIn('oauth') called correctly
- [ ] Error logging for debugging

**Time Estimate**: 2-3 hours

**Risk**: MEDIUM - New route type, locale extraction logic

title: Add OAuth provider to NextAuth config
description:
Add a second Credentials provider with id 'oauth' to src/shared/lib/auth/config.ts

**Context**:
- BE handles Google OAuth flow
- BE redirects to FE callback with 3 parameters: user_id, access_token, email
- This provider validates those parameters and creates NextAuth session

**Implementation**:
- Import zod for schema validation
- Define oauthSchema with fields: userId (string), email (string.email), accessToken (string)
- Add Credentials provider with id 'oauth' after existing Credentials provider
- In authorize(), use oauthSchema.parse() to validate credentials
- Return user object: { id, email, accessToken, role: 'user' }
- Handle errors and return null on validation failure

**Security**:
- accessToken must be stored in JWT callback (already implemented)
- accessToken must NOT be exposed in session callback (already implemented)

**Files**:
- src/shared/lib/auth/config.ts (MODIFY)

**Acceptance Criteria**:
- [ ] OAuth provider added with unique id 'oauth'
- [ ] Zod schema validates all 3 required fields
- [ ] authorize() returns valid user object or null
- [ ] No TypeScript errors
- [ ] Provider matches existing pattern for consistency

**Time Estimate**: 1-2 hours

**Risk**: LOW - Pattern exists in current config
close_reason: Added OAuth provider with Zod validation. All acceptance criteria met: OAuth provider added with unique id 'oauth', Zod schema validates all 3 required fields (userId, email, accessToken), authorize() returns valid user object or null, no TypeScript errors, provider matches existing pattern for consistency.
